note: Temporal dataset: one row per technology x snapshot. Features use only data knowable at the snapshot; outcomes use the horizon after it.

label.note: Realization, not publication popularity: independent confirmation plus the first repository, package, patent or company user after the snapshot, absent before it, for a technology not known to be commercial at the snapshot. Unknown maturity is a flagged feature, not a filter.

split.note: Temporal split by snapshot date; the last labelled snapshots validate and test.

snapshot_percentiles_note: Rank among technologies at the same snapshot (0..1), so scale and money are compared with contemporaries.
